fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: High-growth company with strong margins and a solid balance sheet, albeit with a very high valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimate by 13.5%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY and earnings growth 144.4% YoY indicate rapid expansion.
Gross margin of 76.0% and profit margin of 26.7% demonstrate strong profitability.
Return on equity of 21.1% and return on assets of 10.1% show efficient capital utilization.
Current ratio of 11.30 and quick ratio of 10.55 indicate excellent short-term liquidity.
Total debt of $41.85M is minimal compared to total cash of $1.18B.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 230.85 and forward P/E of 80.67 suggest a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 58.08 and Price/Book of 38.91 also indicate a premium valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 2.80 is somewhat elevated, though offset by strong cash position.
Beta of 3.96 indicates significantly higher volatility than the broader market.
Analyst mean target of $244.97 is substantially below the current spot price.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs is riding strong demand for AI infrastructure, with recent articles highlighting its position as an early player in the AI story. However, some analysts are urging caution, with one suggesting a short position despite a lack of immediate catalysts, and another recommending taking profits off the table due to high valuation. The company recently beat Q1 earnings estimates, and its next earnings date is August 4th.
